newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close at new high riding U.S. wave.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close at new high riding U.S. wave.

text.p: Swedish shares closed at a new high on Tuesday after being infected by an upbeat mood with gains on Wall Street overnight and in early U.S. trade and a stronger dollar.
The Stockholm general index rose 1.56 percent to 2,698.04 after shares worth 4.93 billion crowns changed hands.
"There are continued flows of money from funds into this market and that, combined with the strong dollar, has provided this kind of market," one broker said.
"It is very difficult to see why this market should turn down."
Bluechip stocks were at the front of the charge. Drugs major Astra rose five to 369 crowns while Ericsson closed six higher at 247 crowns.
Holding company Industrivarden posted a 20 percent fall in 1996 profits. Its shares closed 10 up at 390 crowns.
Under the influence of the strong dollar, the forestry sector rose 2.75 percent and the building and construction sector ended 3.15 percent higher.
Insurer Skandia closed 1.5 crowns higher at 228 ahead of releasing its 1996 profits on Wednesday.
